cycle.label: Certification period
cycle.note: New Hampshire licenses run two years from their own issue date (Ac 401.03): 80 hours each period, 4 of them ethics, up to 40 carried forward.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year period (Ac 403.01). Up to 40 hours over the 80 carry to the next period only.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 3 nano-learning hours a year (6 per period).

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of professional ethics each period. No New Hampshire-specific course is required.

newLicensee.note: New licensees: at least 20 hours for each year before renewal

licenseDateHint: Two years from your license's issue or last renewal date. (Some licenses from the 2023 transition run three years and need 120 hours.)
issueDateHint: If you were newly licensed during this period, about 20 hours a year are due.
limitsNotTracked: Authoring: max 50%; instructing: max 50% (preparation up to twice the presentation time).
Three-year transition licenses: 120 hours, carry up to 60 — not modelled.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for at least 4 years from the renewal date.
toVerify: New licensees: 20 hours per year before renewal, prorated by full month; ethics kept at 4.
Whether the 20-a-year minimum applies to everyone (OPLC page) or only new/reactivated licensees (Ac 403.01(b)).
